<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-1705-04-58" status="unreviewed">yang ‹<rs type="person" ana="">rtsang pa</rs>› 'dzin stangs rang gi sgro btags pa la 'jug pa log shes kyi mtshan nyid du khas blangs pa la 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na re de chod du shes bya'i don dang mi mthun par 'dzin pa ‹yin pa› cis 'gog | de ltar na zla ba 2 snang gi shes pa log shes ma <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="10a9"/> yin par 'gyur te shes bya'i don dang 'thun pa'i phyir ro zhe na | 
         'o na sngo 'dzin kyang sngon po la ltos nas log shes ma yin par 'gyur te rang gi sgro btags pa la 'jug pa med pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
